status: Complete original DDraw1 execute-data and live execute-buffer update assertions pass. Overall original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: SetExecuteData stores the exact-sized descriptor as opaque metadata without rejecting advisory vertex counts or offsets or allocating from them. GetExecuteData continues to return the complete descriptor regardless of the caller size value. Existing lock/error behavior is preserved.

Validate/Optimize check the physical instruction range with 64-bit arithmetic before reading instructions. Actual PROCESSVERTICES validates operation and physical source bytes before allocation, independently of metadata dwVertexCount, and grows the processed destination storage only when required by the live instruction. Growth retains prior vertices and zeroes new slots, with atomic allocation failure and overflow rejection. Data and instruction rewrites are consumed at execution time.

Existing viewport/execute fixture now models heap-backed processed storage and native destination growth, retaining all original frozen position/clip, payload, lighting-isolation and failure-prefix assertions. Execute-buffer private inner-device retention is unchanged.
